name: FAB (First Abu Dhabi Bank)
note: The UAE's largest bank, listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. Abu Dhabi's state fund Mubadala is its largest shareholder with 37.9% (claim fab-mubadala-stake). On the chest, sleeves and side panels of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG kit; listed as a main sponsor on the team's website.
